fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Miss Fortune's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 100 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=50% + 10% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 10% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, halved to {{as|{{pp|key=%|50/2 to 100/2 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=25% + 5% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 5% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.
